item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"ARC-AGI-2 public test problems, official scoring software and verified-testing rules are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The passage describes inferring unfamiliar rules, AI-system comparisons and broader reasoning claims."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs, new inputs and required output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Two attempts, verified settings and spending limits are described; other testing routes can differ."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact grid matching, averaging within problems and averaging problem scores are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring transformations from examples is explicitly linked to learning new rules."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty testing and duplicate-rule removal support selection, but broader reasoning coverage is not established."},{"id":8,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developers reviewed puzzles, and subsequent corrections addressed coloured squares and unclear examples."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise rule inference and combining ideas, but cover only two-dimensional grids."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching measures successful grid completion, but gives no credit for partially correct grids."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging method is explicit, but support for its interpretation as an ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct answers, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs; comprehensive validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI comparisons and human difficulty results provide context, but the human study includes puzzles outside the final sets."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run; the supplied materials do not establish a repeated-run study."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changing instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No estimates or ranges of repeated-run score variation are provided."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Resistance to program searches and repeated solution rules was addressed, but other routes remain unresolved."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public problems remain accessible and leakage remains possible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific adaptation is discouraged, and verified feedback is not offered for repeated improvement."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings are recorded and test sets were matched for human difficulty; other testing routes can differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the scoped public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and code-review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated records identify corrected problems and code changes, but affected AI scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-reasoning claims have direct support; broader connections to intelligence lack supplied validation."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire distinguishes documented procedures from evidence supporting broader interpretations. Its testing items should record that marking tests occurred without implying comprehensive validation. Public evaluations and verified hidden evaluations require separate attention because their conditions differ.","supported_claims":["The benchmark tests inference of grid transformations from worked examples.","Official scoring permits two attempts and averages input success within each problem.","Human solving results informed selection of test sets with similar human difficulty."],"documented_problems":["Exact matching gives no credit for a partly correct grid.","Software problem scores can be fractional, while the dataset's 'fully solved' description requires every input to be correct.","Corrections do not include recalculation of every affected AI score."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variation and sensitivity to instructions or presentation.","Evidence connecting grid scores to performance outside these puzzles.","Comprehensive validation of marking and unintended routes to points."],"reinterpretations":["A fractional problem score represents the proportion of new inputs solved, not a partly correct output grid.","Matching test sets for human difficulty does not establish stable AI scores.","Broader intelligence relationships remain unresolved rather than disproved."],"closing_note":"Items 8 and 12 can blur whether checking occurred with whether it was comprehensive. Item 14 also needs care: one-run verified testing does not establish that no repeated-run research exists."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 question-answer pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-rule retrieval, document understanding, drawing interpretation and AI comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules or images, and text or yes/no responses are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but exact historical inputs and settings are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text comparison, yes/no credit, explanation scoring and equal weighting of six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link the tasks to parts of engineers' work with rules and designs."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real engineering materials support relevance, but one rulebook and uneven task groups limit representativeness."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several engineering-document tasks, but one rulebook and limited tasks constrain coverage."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions receive credit, but wording, punctuation and incomplete reference answers can affect marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but evidence supporting the combined score or distinct skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and examination of scoring problems show testing occurred; complete accuracy and consistency validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide comparisons, but human-engineer results are absent and information supplies differ."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the inputs, so they do not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors examine changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage-set variation provides limited evidence, but uncertainty is insufficient for judging small differences in the main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity are examined, but unintended scoring routes are not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but protected evaluation data and systematic overlap checks are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules for training on questions and repeatedly submitting results were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No evidence establishes prediction of performance on other standards or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information supplies are described, but some systems receive whole rulebooks and others retrieved passages."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials permit inspection, but exact historical software, inputs and settings are not fully linked to results."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The review did not find a licence file or complete responsible-reuse rules."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but a clear record explaining score effects was not found."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges scope and marking limits, while broader engineering interpretations and fine rankings need additional support."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire helps distinguish relevance to engineering tasks from evidence of broader competence. It also separates experiments that change inputs from identical repeated runs. Marking-test existence, marking adequacy and reproducibility require separate judgments.","supported_claims":["The benchmark examines six types of tasks using Formula SAE rules and vehicle materials.","Experiments investigate effects of passages, labels, scale bars and highlighted images.","Reported results depend on both the AI and the information supplied to it."],"documented_problems":["Wording and formatting can affect credit, including missing commas and valid rules absent from references.","Task groups are highly uneven, ranging from 1,192 individual-rule questions to 16 performance questions.","Always answering 'yes' would earn decision credit on the described scale-bar drawings, which all comply.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding published question count."],"missing_information":["Identical-condition repeated runs and sufficient uncertainty for close model comparisons.","Comprehensive marking accuracy and consistency validation.","Complete result-linked historical inputs, settings and software.","Clear training, repeated-submission, licensing and responsible-reuse rules.","Evidence of transfer to other technical documents or engineering projects."],"reinterpretations":["Passage-set variation measures sensitivity to changed information rather than identical-run variability.","The scale-bar shortcut is an inferred opportunity, not evidence that any tested AI used it.","An overall score combines equally weighted task groups; distinct underlying skill measurement is not established.","Failure to find reuse permissions does not establish that reuse is prohibited."],"closing_note":"Items 12 and 17 leave some ambiguity about how much checking is enough. Item 16 should distinguish uncertainty under changed passages from uncertainty under identical repeated conditions."}]}
